reviews.title: This is a great external hard drive
reviews.comment:
I used this to play games on my laptop which only had a 500gb hard drive this plugged right in and I was able to play AAA game titles with the games installed on this hard drive using the provided cable. It is now plugged into my desktop and I don't think I will ever get rid of this drive. 

The construction feels great port feels like it is a quality port transfer speeds are fantastic with this drive and have ran into no problems with this drive it self 

The one downside is that out of the 4000gb in the drive only 3600gb was actually available to be used out of the box I know drives need some space for their own software and whatnot on there but 400gbs seems excessive for that. That is the only downside to this drive and that may be able to be fixed but I have not found a way but also not really looked into it. With that said I would still recommend it
